model_sql:
select
    o.order_id,
    o.amount,
    coalesce(sum(p.paid_amount), 0) as paid,
    case
        when coalesce(sum(p.paid_amount), 0) >= o.amount then 'paid'
        when coalesce(sum(p.paid_amount), 0) > 0 then 'partial'
        else 'unpaid'
    end as payment_status
from {{ source('legacy', 'orders') }} o
left join {{ source('legacy', 'payments') }} p
    on p.order_id = o.order_id
group by o.order_id, o.amount

explanation: This procedure builds a payment status report with one row per order. For each order it adds up all payments recorded against it and compares that total with the order amount. The status is 'paid' when the total covers the order, 'partial' when some money has been received but not enough, and 'unpaid' when nothing has been received.
